connections.mappingDefaultHint: Unmapped or empty rows are not saved; empty fields fall back to built-in defaults, and the account name always needs a source.
connections.dryRunResult: Dry run: {{create}} accounts to create, {{update}} to update, {{disable}} to disable; {{groups}} organization changes
connections.dryRunGuarded: Delete guard tripped: {{count}} accounts would be disabled, sync blocked
connections.mappingFallbackHint: Takes the first non-empty source field
connections.runAlreadyRunning: This source is already syncing; reusing the current task
connections.tagsPlaceholder: Type a time and press Enter, e.g. 03:00
connections.errScheduleInterval: Interval mode requires a positive number of seconds
connections.errScheduleTimes: Daily mode requires at least one run time
connections.errScheduleCron: Cron expression must have 5 fields (minute hour day month weekday)
connections.reconcileHint: Check whether local accounts of "{{name}}" really exist downstream; differences are only reported until you confirm.
connections.reconcileUnknownHint: "Unknown" means the downstream did not return a reliable answer (often missing permission or a changed API). It is never treated as missing, so nothing gets created twice — but it needs a manual look.
connections.reconcileTruncated: This run hit the per-run limit (100 accounts); run it again to check the rest.

asyncd.title: Task center
asyncd.subtitle: Async tasks and schedules (asyncd): backlog, failures, manual retry of dead letters, and schedule toggles
asyncd.schedulesHint: Schedules are declared in code and registered automatically; disable one temporarily (e.g. maintenance window)
asyncd.emptyHint: The queue is idle; backlog and dead letters will show up here.
